name: hero-scenes
about: Canvas hero animations for the kit's .hero-anim slot: flow (business info streams into a site and out to AI answer cards), orb, answer, blocks, pins and page. One small engine with no library. Decoration only: the canvas is aria-hidden and the words stay in the page's HTML. Each scene keeps the slot's rules: no layout shift, it runs only while on screen and the tab is visible, reduced motion gets one still frame. Colours come from the site's own tokens; the assistant names, the other words, the font and which scenes may run come from the settings. A site adds its own scene with register().

scenes.default: flow, orb, answer, blocks, pins, page

assistants.default: AI search, AI chat, AI answers

cited.default: yourbusiness.com: cited in the answer | cited in the answer
